name: Gyarados

abilities.name: intimidate
abilities.effect: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.

abilities.name: moxie
abilities.effect: Raises Attack one stage upon KOing a Pokémon.

genderDifference: Male has blue barbels while female has white barbels

kanto.flavorText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

original-johto.flavorText: It appears when­ ever there is world conflict, burning down any place it travels through.

hoenn.flavorText: It is an extremely vicious and violent POKéMON. When humans begin to fight, it will appear and burn everything to the ground with intensely hot flames.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: In ancient literature, there is a record of a GYARADOS that razed a village when violence flared.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Once it begins to rampage, a GYARADOS will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

updated-johto.flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

original-unova.flavorText: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

updated-unova.flavorText: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

kalos.flavorText: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Once Gyarados goes on a rampage, its ferociously violent blood doesn’t calm until it has burned everything down. There are records of this Pokémon’s rampages lasting a whole month.

original-alola.flavorText: There are people who swear that any place Gyarados appears is fated for destruction.

updated-alola.flavorText: The energy from evolution stimulated its brain cells strongly, causing it to become very ferocious.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Brutally vicious and enormously destructive. Known for totally destroying cities in ancient times.

swsh.flavorText: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.
